entries.subject: USGS 2026 Cassini ISS CL1/CB3 938 nm mosaic
entries.finding: Selected 32-pixels-per-degree ISS mosaic supplies Near-infrared; exact zero is missing while dark dunes and lakes remain observed.

entries.subject: Cassini RADAR MIDR hemispheres
entries.finding: Paired MIDR products supply Radar; mapped backscatter is not visible-light color.

entries.subject: Cassini 2019 GTDR measured-height hemispheres
entries.finding: GTIED products supply measured Topography on the stated reference surface and retain missing regions.

entries.subject: Cassini 2019 GTDR interpolated-height hemispheres
entries.finding: GTDED products supply Interpolated topography as its own quantity rather than filling measured-height gaps.

entries.subject: Cassini 2019 GTDR coverage-distance hemispheres
entries.finding: GTFED products supply Coverage distance, preserving its diagnostic meaning instead of treating it as terrain.

entries.subject: Titan global geomorphology vector dataset
entries.finding: Mendeley geomorphology data supplies categorical Geology; source classes are not observation pixels or elevation.

entries.subject: 2019 VIMS/ISS enhanced-color composite
entries.finding: The candidate fills missing VIMS color and removes seams without a validity mask, so observed coverage cannot be established.
entries.revisitWhen: A validity mask and registration distinguish observed VIMS pixels from fills.

entries.subject: Superseded Cornell cube ZIPs and byte-browse products
entries.finding: They remain research evidence but are not rendered after selection of retained GTDR products.
entries.revisitWhen: A source review establishes a distinct mapped quantity with preserved values and coverage.

entries.subject: Photometric law for the lighting overlays
entries.finding: No disc law exists for the 938 nm surface map. Titan's limb at that wavelength is set by haze scattering, and the published 938 nm photometry is a radiative-transfer model with 16 parameters, not a disk function the photometry library can hold. Titan keeps the shared sphere bank.
entries.revisitWhen: A published centre-to-limb law for Titan's disc at 938 nm with its fitted emission range, or a radiative-transfer limb profile the preparation can read.
